title: PluginCapabilities
description: Describes the declarative capabilities of a plugin, such as supported importers.

contentProviders.description: List of content providers provided by the plugin.

importers.description: List of supported modpack importers provided by the plugin.

updaters.description: List of supported modpack updaters provided by the plugin.

description.description: Optional detailed description of what this capability does.

handlers.description: Set of functions provided by the plugin to handle content operations.

icon.description: Optional icon file name or URL for the UI.

id.description: Identifier for the capability (lowercase, kebab/underscore allowed).

platform.description:
The platform whose content this provider serves (`modrinth`, `curseforge`): what an
install plan's `providerRef` names to point at content without naming a plugin. Several
providers may serve one platform; the launcher picks which one is asked.

A provider declaring a platform must implement `resolveFile`. Leave it out when the
provider hosts no content of its own and cannot be the target of a `providerRef`.

description.description: Optional detailed description of what this capability does.

fieldLabel.description: Optional field label shown in the importer UI.

handler.description: Plugin function name to handle this capability call.

icon.description: Optional icon file name or URL for the UI.

id.description: Identifier for the capability (lowercase, kebab/underscore allowed).

supportedExtensions.description: List of supported file extensions, e.g., [`zip`, `mrpack`].

description.description: Optional detailed description of what this capability does.

handler.description: Plugin function name to handle this capability call.

icon.description: Optional icon file name or URL for the UI.

id.description: Identifier for the capability (lowercase, kebab/underscore allowed).

ProviderHandlers.description:
Names of plugin functions that implement specific content provider logic.

Which of the optional operations a provider supports follows from which handlers it names:
an operation without a handler is reported as unsupported.

checkCompatibility.description: Optional function to check if a specific content item is compatible with current environment.

getContent.description: Function to get detailed information about a specific piece of content.

getContentsMetadata.description:
Optional function describing projects to show installed content by (name, icon, author).
Takes `GetContentsMetadataParamsDto`, returns a list of `ContentMetadataDto`. Without it the
provider's content is shown by file alone.

getVersionsMetadata.description:
Optional function giving the version number of installed files. Takes
`GetVersionsMetadataParamsDto`, returns a list of `ContentVersionMetadataDto`. Without it the files are shown
without a version.

listVersion.description: Optional function to list available versions of a specific content item.

resolveFile.description:
Optional function telling which file a `providerRef` of the provider's `platform` stands
for. Takes `ResolveFileParamsDto`, returns `ResolvedFileDto`. Required with `platform`.

resolveInstallPlan.description:
Optional function describing everything to install for a piece of content, a single mod
and a whole modpack alike. Takes `ResolveInstallPlanParamsDto`, returns `InstallPlanDto`.

resolvePackMetadata.description:
Optional function describing a pack without resolving its files: the preview before
installing and the check for updates. Takes `PackSourceDto`, returns `PackMetadataDto`.

search.description: Function to search for content within the provider.
